Questions & Answers

Everything you need before ordering

How do I order?

Add gifts to your cart, tap Checkout, enter your details, pay by bank transfer, type your payment details, then tap Continue Order on WhatsApp. Everything is sent to Joseph in one message.

Can I customise items?

Yes! Rings, necklaces, mugs, pillows, blankets, hoodies and more can carry your name, photo or design. Add the details at checkout.

Do you deliver?

Yes, we deliver to your address. We'll confirm the time on WhatsApp.
